purpose: small material style swatch; no full hull mapping
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE small game material swatch for style matching only, NOT a ship or full scene. Input image is a native 192x192 crop of the approved project art and is the authoritative style reference. Match its restrained hand-painted game illustration language closely: grey-brown old wood, desaturated blue-grey shadows, crisp but varying dark structural edges, short restrained brush marks that FOLLOW individual planks, small local wear, small upper-left warm-grey edge highlights. No photographic surface, no 3D, no flat vector, no uniform thick black outline, no giant impasto daubs, no orange-gold wash, no noisy full-surface grain, no painted text or UI. Preserve the reference's readable timber scale: when the whole swatch is reduced to 192x192, one plank is about 18-28 px tall, wear is mostly 1-3px marks and dark seams about 1-3px. Do not recreate machinery, people, ocean or light fixtures visible in the reference crop. Square opaque swatch, material fills canvas. Create a NEW coherent painted sample, not a zoomed copy or collage. Subject: close side-view of a simple T-junction between a thick vertical timber post and a horizontal timber beam, with a small diagonal timber brace in one corner. Wood structure is clearly articulated, dark occlusion only at the joints, narrow restrained upper-left edge light, cooler right-facing planes. Background is simple dark grey-brown vertical wall boards. Very sparse irregular iron fasteners, no repeated grid. All strokes follow the member they belong to; light and wear reveal the beam turn, not a continuous texture stamped across the joint. No wheel, machine, lamp, furniture or scenery.
negative_prompt: photographic wood, 3D, abstract impasto, large daubs, orange gold wash, noisy texture, flat vectors, thick uniform cartoon outline, text, UI, scenery

references.rights: approved internal project reference; no runtime crop reuse
